data.name: I Against Me
data.detailed_description:
There's something wrong with your house. Everyone is acting strangely, something is always watching you, and the face you see in the mirror sometimes isn't your own.

I Against Me is a first-person psychological horror game about returning home to a nightmare you can't wake from. A doppelgänger is trying to erase you. It stalks your childhood home, learns your habits, threatens the people you love, and wants your life. You must uncover its origins and find a way to stop it before you are replaced forever.

Find the Hidden Truth

Your past holds the key. Search for clues in the world around you. Whether a misplaced object, a conversation, a photograph that has changed. Piece together the story of the entity that is haunting you and discover the terrible truth of its connection to your family.

The Danger Gets Worse

Your only weapon is your wits. Watch, listen, and learn the patterns of your other self. But be warned.. the closer you get to the truth, the more aggressive and cunning it becomes. The subtle whispers will turn to violent screams, and the fleeting shadows will begin to chase you through the halls.

Key Features:

  • A Story of Identity and Fear: This is more than a ghost hunt. It's a deep psychological narrative about memory, family secrets, and the terror of being forgotten.

  • It Watches. It Learns: Face a doppelgänger that actively responds to your progress. Its escalating aggression creates a constant, terrifying state of suspense. But is its presence a curse, or a desperate warning?

  • A World Full of Clues: Explore a detailed home brought to life in a surreal, comic-book art style. Every corner holds a clue, and every shadow could be hiding your other self.

Will you lose yourself to the thing wearing your face?

Wishlist I Against Me now and prepare to confront the enemy within.

data.short_description: Returning home should feel safe, but the face in the mirror is no longer yours. A perfect copy of you stalks the halls, and it wants your life. Piece together the dark mystery of your doppelganger, where the truth doesn't set you free. It only brings your copy closer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Performance may be lower in areas with intense real-time reflections.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Solid State Drive (SSD) Recommended for faster loading.
